item.title: Reebok FloatZig Tread Review 2026 (GQ)
item.description: With a lower stack and firmer feel, this stripped-down trainer favors stability over squish, making it a smart pick for intervals and hybrid workouts.

item.title: ‘Love Story’ Star Paul Anthony Kelly Is on a Great Jacket Streak
item.description: The actor, who plays JFK Jr., is showcasing some seriously enviable outerwear on this press tour.

item.title: 15 Best Winter Colognes Cut Through the Cold Air in 2026
item.description: Richly textured, distinctive, and anything but basic—just like your turtleneck.

item.title: A Skull Cap Beanie Is the Better Way to Protect Your Noggin
item.description: The cuffed watch caps endemic to third-wave coffee shops are cringe. Buy a noggin-hugging skully instead.

item.title: The Best Vintage Watches From the J. Press NYFW Show
item.description: With help from vintage watch dealer Eric Wind, J. Press once again paired its new collection with a parade of period-correct timepieces.

item.title: What Ozempic Taught Me About Style and Self-Worth
item.description: I have always loved clothes. Gaining 100 pounds robbed me of my sense of style, but not my interest in fashion. Nine months on GLP-1s and a diary changed everything all over again.

item.title: Why the Coolest Cologne Is One You Can Barely Smell at All
item.description: Once upon a time, the most popular scents were meant to overpower the room. Now, the most coveted fragrances announce themselves with a whisper.

item.title: Magnesium for Migraines: How the Nutrient Can Help
item.description: Supplementing your diet with magnesium can reduce the frequency, intensity, and duration of a migraine. Neurologists share the ideal amount and types to take.

item.title: How a Skeleton Olympian Trains for Gold
item.description: “Skeleton athletes are basically a hybrid between a weight-lifter and a sprinter,” says Britain’s 28-year-old gold medalist skeleton ‘slider’ Matt Weston.

item.title: One of Hip-Hop’s Most Famous Watches Is Up for Sale
item.description: Pharrell Williams is auctioning off a pair of Jacob & Co. Five Time Zones, plus a bunch of other extremely diamond-forward jewellery.
